scholarships.title: SEARCA Full Master's and PhD Scholarship Program
scholarships.official_source: Southeast Asian Regional Center for Graduate Study and Research in Agriculture (SEARCA)

existing.description: SEARCA's Full Master's and PhD Scholarship Program is fully funded by SEARCA for nationals of SEAMEO member countries who are regular employees of academic or research institutions or government agencies. Scholars take master's or doctoral degrees in agriculture, forestry and related sciences at SEARCA study posts in Indonesia, Thailand, Malaysia and the Philippines. For academic year 2027-2028 SEARCA publishes a staged timeline in which applications go first to the applicant's national Ministry of Higher Education between 1 September and 31 October 2026, then shortlisted candidates upload the same documents through the SEARCA iSCHO portal between 1 and 31 December 2026.
existing.application_period: 1 September - 31 October 2026 (submission to the national Ministry of Higher Education); shortlisted applicants then submit through the SEARCA iSCHO portal 1-31 December 2026
existing.program_type: Regional graduate scholarship run by an intergovernmental research and training centre
